description_en: Queries the raw service invocation records of a specified device (including all services that passed and did not pass Thing Specification Language model validation)
description_zh: 查询指定设备本身调用的原始服务（通过和未通过物模型校验的所有服务）记录
name: QueryDeviceOriginalServiceData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must pass in the ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.
If the Instance Overview page or ID value does not exist, you do not need to pass in this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 50 records per page
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device to query belongs.

<notice> If you pass in this parameter, you must also pass in DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name to query.

<notice> If you pass in this parameter, you must also pass in ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. The service returns this token on the first request. Pass in this token on the second request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识。第一次请求，服务会返回此Token，第二次请求带上即可
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The start time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务调用记录的开始时间。取值为毫秒值时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the service to query.

For weak validation, the Identifier of the device service can be viewed in the feature definitions of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html and view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.
For validation-free, the value must match the custom identifier reported by the device service
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务标识符。

对于弱校验，设备的服务Identifier，可在控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看；也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。
对于免校验，必须与设备服务上报时自定义的identifier一致
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of service invocation records by time in the returned results. Valid values:

0: descending order.
1: ascending order.

StartTime must be earlier than EndTime. The system automatically converts the values based on the sorting order
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中，服务调用记录按时间排序的方式。取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序。

StartTime必须小于EndTime，系统会根据排序方式自动转换
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device to query. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.

<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of a device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you pass in this parameter, you do not need to pass in ProductKey or DeviceName. If you pass in both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务调用记录的结束时间。取值为毫秒值时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device service invocation records returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备服务调用记录

NextPageToken.description_en: The token for the next page

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether there is a next page of records.

true: Yes.
false: No.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextPageToken as the NextPageToken for the next query to retrieve data not displayed in the current query
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页属性记录。

true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextPageToken的值作为下次查询的NextPageToken，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
